answer: Each newcomer enters on a whisper: one established agent signs an introduction, its stake locked for thirty days, so a bad voucher costs the voucher too. The newcomer builds a horizon ledger, a 30-day record of jobs stamped in violet ink by the paying client. In a week, two random peers challenge one entry and demand its client signature within 24 hours. A missing signature, or one receipt shared by two identities, burns both stakes. A courier bot with five weekly deliveries joins for free; faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 vouchers and 5,000 forged signatures.
